title: How Much and How Long: mennyibe kerül, érvényes

sections.title: Price and validity
sections.content: Ask the price the same way you already do for anything else: Mennyibe kerül egy jegy? To say how long a pass lasts, reuse -ra/-re, this time for duration rather than direction: egy hónapra érvényes ("valid for a month"). érvényes ("valid") pairs naturally with -ra/-re.

items.english: The pass is valid for a month.
I buy a ticket at the machine.

sections.content: -ra/-re for duration works the same way elsewhere too: egy hétre megyek Budapestre ("I'm going to Budapest for a week") — the case doesn't care whether it's marking a destination or a length of time.
